name: ledgerly
description: UK tax & filing app for sole traders and small businesses — monorepo root

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace apps/frontend --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/backend --if-present && npm run lint --workspace apps/frontend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/frontend --if-present
